title: API keys can handle game-scale traffic
summary:
A tuning day: higher-throughput API keys, sturdier model fallbacks, stricter image validation, and more reliable community posting.

API key rate limits now reach 10,000 requests per second for high-volume games and other apps that prefer their infrastructure not to blink during a busy moment.

Text fallback configurations now receive a default max_tokens value, making Claude fallback behavior more predictable when a primary model takes the scenic route.

The Enter image flow now validates model selections with a proper enum, catching unsupported choices before they become mysterious downstream behavior.
